summary: NexLev audit of @FactTechz — a 21.5M subscriber Hindi facts/science channel earning $389,785/month ($4.68M/year). 11.74 BILLION total views across 2,500 videos in 10 years. MIXED channel (long-form + Shorts) with $4.31 long RPM. 78% Tier 1 traffic despite being India-based (likely large NRI diaspora audience). Compared against all previously analyzed channels.
